ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pigmentation dominates the central 60% of both lobes, contrasted against low-intensity black margins and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white focal regions in the center of both lobes; left lobe distal region exhibits vertical black mottling; right lobe mid-section contains a prominent diagonal low-intensity linear streak bisecting the high-intensity field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree aperture; base of the notch is partially occluded by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities (micro-serrations) along the entire trailing boundary; several deep V-shaped indentations visible on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed, slightly recurved lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular white pixel clusters localized on the distal tip of the left lobe and along the anterior margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal low-intensity linear scar on the right lobe; series of parallel vertical 'rake' marks on the left lobe breaking the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent diagonal linear trauma on the right fluke lobe; irregular trailing edge with potential historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical pigmentation pattern characterized by the clean diagonal bisecting line on the right lobe versus the mottled vertical streaks on the left.
